name: Edinburgh
about: August brings the world-famous Fringe Festival (also the busiest, priciest month), winter is dark, cold and quiet.
overview: A medieval Old Town beneath a volcanic castle rock, built for wandering closes and wynds between whisky bars.
costOverview: Coffee and a pint barely register — whisky tastings and castle admission are the real one-time costs most visitors budget for.

specialSeasons.text: The Fringe Festival transforms the city with thousands of shows — also the busiest, priciest time to visit.
